text:
raj: Heads-up — planning the tenant metadata schema change for next Monday in the late-night window. Thinking 00:30-01:15 UTC. Needs a short backfill and a quiesce. Can we pin a slot?
carla: @raj ok for me. can we keep the initial canary to 5% of tenants? :eyes:
sara: +1 for canary. the alter is cheap but the backfill touches a lot of rows. we should throttle. proposal: batch-size 5k, sleep 200ms between batches.
linus: curious about locks — ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN with DEFAULT could lock. prefer ADD COLUMN NULL then backfill then SET DEFAULT. sample plan:
```sql
ALTER TABLE tenants ADD COLUMN metadata jsonb;
-- backfill in app code: set metadata = '{}' where metadata is null
ALTER TABLE tenants ALTER COLUMN metadata SET DEFAULT '{}';
```
raj: good call. we'll do the three-step. backfill command for preflight is:
```bash
python infra/backfill.py --table tenants --col metadata --batch-size 5000 --sleep-ms 200 --rate-limit 5
```
carla: can we gate the rollout behind a feature flag tenant_meta_migrate? deploy will flip it after canary passes.
jamie-oncall: I'll be oncall that night. Add me to the release notes / runbook. If locks spike, i'll pause.
deploybot: Scheduled canary run created: job id cb-2026-07-12-01, window 00:30-00:45 UTC, targets ~5% tenants. Logs at https://go/release/jobs/cb-2026-07-12-01 :rocket:
devtools-bot: Added release note stub: go/release/notes/tenant-meta-migration. Please expand with rollback criteria.
sara: Rollback criteria suggestion: abort and rollback if any of:
- >0.5% requests see db_lock_time > 200ms for >2 consecutive 5m windows
- row-level lock waits increase >5x baseline
- error rate for write path >0.5%
carla: also add: if backfill job latency causes p99 tokenization latency to regress >100ms, abort.
linus: operational notes: pauseable backfill command, check `pg_stat_activity` for long-running `ALTER` queries, and we should throttle until replica catchup < 10s.
raj: I'll update the runbook. small checklist:
- pin schema version in release config to v20260712-tenantmeta-rc1
- set canary percent to 5%
- feature flag tenant_meta_migrate off initially
- canary monitor dashboards: db_lock_time, row_lock_waits, p99-app-latency, replica-lag
- oncall: @jamie-oncall
carla: ping me when the preflight backfill finishes. I'll sanity-check sample tenants.
deploybot: Canary started (cb-2026-07-12-01) — canary targeting 512 tenants, backfill batches running. Monitor: https://go/mon/cb-2026-07-12-01
jamie-oncall: I'm watching. alert thresholds set. If I see lock_wait > 400ms sustained, i'll hit the abort step. :thumbsup:
sara: One more: ensure we keep a DB snapshot before the non-null set-default step. quick pg_dump of schema only.
raj: noted. I'll upload the snapshot link and the finalized runbook to the release note page. Thanks all.
deploybot: Canary completed (cb-2026-07-12-01) — no regressions observed. Ready to expand to 20% if we get thumbs.
